Advance 2 seconds and identify the leader in the Database panel. From SQL-CLIENT, send CREATE TABLE sensors (id, value) to that leader's individual IP (10.90.0.11/12/13), port 8080, key database-key. INSERT and SELECT respond only after majority confirmation. Power off the leader, advance 2 seconds, and query the new leader: the committed data persists. Isolate only the old leader's two dedicated cables to study a partition: it may keep its local role, but it does not report success without a majority. SELECT also requires fresh confirmation. A write timeout has an indeterminate outcome; query before retrying. There is no automatic address or TCP failover. Automatic compaction; up to 256 retained entries, 128 uncommitted entries, and 512 KiB per checkpoint. Removing a member/group disables the databases while preserving their local data.
